title: Apparent grainlessness is functional invariability, and training changes it

statements.text: The apparent homogeneity of qualia is a functional invariability akin to cognitive impenetrability, and it is plastic. Training a palate or an ear makes what was atomic and unanalyzable compound and describable, as a listener can come to hear the harmonic in a plucked guitar string.

sources.quote: This putative grainlessness, I hypothesize, is nothing but a sort of functional invariability
